turns.instruction:
Analyze the attached 18 m symmetric double-slope trapezoidal truss in the global X-Z plane. The horizontal bottom chord has six 3 m panels: B0 through B6 at x=0,3,6,9,12,15,18 m and z=0. Top nodes T0 through T6 have the same x coordinates and z=1.6,1.9,2.2,2.5,2.2,1.9,1.6 m. The top slope is +1/10 from x=0 to 9 m and -1/10 from x=9 to 18 m. Connect adjacent nodes along each chord, add all seven verticals Bi-Ti including both end verticals, and add exactly T0-B1, T1-B2, T2-B3, T3-B4, T4-B5 and T5-B6 as web diagonals. Use the full 25-member endpoint table and axial-only, pin-jointed rods. B0 is a pin; B6 is a bilateral vertical roller free in global X. Case D applies 15 kN downward (global -Z) only at each of B1 through B5. Use the supplied material and area records and run first-order linear static analysis in OpenSees with self-weight disabled. Report signed ux and uz of all five loaded bottom nodes, signed N for every bottom-chord, top-chord and web member, and Fx/Fz reactions at both supports. N is positive in tension. Identify D, node/member IDs and units for every output.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
